risk_if_not_implemented: Without Authorized Individuals For Hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), cloud-hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be misconfigured, over-exposed or governed inconsistently with on-premises controls. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Control Reciprocity
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to define instances of control reciprocity within assessment boundaries.
compensating_control_1.justification: Control Reciprocity (CPL-14) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Authorized Individuals For Hosted Assets, Applications & Services (CLD-12.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Authorized Individuals For Hosted Assets, Applications & Services (CLD-12.1) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
